segments.name: Innovative medical products
segments.description: Designs, develops, manufactures and markets innovative medical products, mainly thrombectomy and embolization and access devices, sold to specialist physicians and healthcare providers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating and reportable segment and its sole business activity consists of the design, development, manufacturing and marketing of innovative medical products.

revenueModel.text: Healthcare providers and distributors pay for the delivery of the Company's medical device products.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company derives revenue by selling our medical devices to healthcare providers, direct sales organizations, and distributors.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company wound down and exited its immersive healthcare business.
changes.evidence: During the year ended December 31, 2024, we made the strategic decision to wind down and exit our immersive healthcare business
